rows.context_and_review_note: Retained Selection by drawing the outline as functional free-form/lasso wording. asti is the nominal selection, s ussunɣ the method, and n yiri the attached-state outline noun. It avoids free/no-cost ambiguity and does not describe a series of polygon vertices. PaintCanvas.kt:788 extends trace continuously with pointer movement; :816 closes the trace and calls document.select(r,trace). The bounding rectangle is an allocation/geometry envelope, while the trace supplies the selection mask; :815 rectangular SELECT instead passes bounds without that mask. The label names outline drawing rather than limiting the contents to a rectangle or invoking the polygon tool. It is longer than the English label and has not been rendered in tool buttons.

Retained ssutl, exactly the verb already used in reviewed ui_rotate_90_clockwise and ui_rotate_180, without those commands’ angles or direction. PaintCanvas.kt:580 draws it beside the circular rotation grip; :587 uses VerticalCanvasCaption. :626–630 derives angle change around the selection centre, normalizes the angle and only snaps extremely near cardinal angles, so this is arbitrary rotation rather than a fixed 90/180 action. It does not rotate the whole document, choose only clockwise motion, or change reflection axes. The compact one-word label is appropriate, but no on-canvas clipping/vertical-layout test was performed.
